name: Twitter Automations
tagline: Three creator automations for X: reply-triggered DMs, follower screening and a watchlist
description: Bundles three separate X workflows behind one assistant. It watches a post for a trigger word in the replies and opens a message with whoever used it, filters arriving followers so only profiles past an audience threshold you set land in your queue, and keeps a running eye on a private roster of accounts.
author: theadvisorbtc
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
